description: Debezium row of inventory.contacts -> contact document: value copied to email or phone by kind, so each kind gets its own lookup rules

script.description: kind EMAIL -> email (lowercase lookup + fragments), kind PHONE -> phone (digits / last 4); value stays the display value. verified_at: MicroTimestamp -> ISO-8601
script.source: if (ctx.kind == 'EMAIL') { ctx.email = ctx.value; } else if (ctx.kind == 'PHONE') { ctx.phone = ctx.value; } if (ctx.verified_at instanceof Number) { ctx.verified_at = Instant.EPOCH.plus(((Number) ctx.verified_at).longValue(), ChronoUnit.MICROS).toString(); }
